snippet.title: Aster Gets Armed  - Demo OUT NOW! SAGExpo 2026
snippet.description:
Play it now from the SAGExpo website! https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/aster-gets-armed-sage-26-demo.2977/ 

PUNCH and DASH your way to victory and decide the fate of Aster’s broken friendships, in this honey-sweet action-packed 'punch-‘em-up'! A short demo featuring the first stage and a bunch of cutscenes. Can you unlock the secret comic?

Follow the game on Bluesky for updates: https://bsky.app/profile/astergetsarmed.bsky.social

Placeholder music (until I learn to make some cool tunes of my own): Sonic Riders Zero Gravity - Blast Town
